summary: Aflac Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose the issuance of $500 million aggregate principal amount of 5.150% Senior Notes due 2036 pursuant to an existing shelf registration statement. The offering was made via an underwriting agreement with representatives Goldman Sachs, Mizuho, SMBC Nikko, and Wells Fargo. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, and the notes are unsecured senior obligations ranking equally with existing unsecured debt. No special situation elements are present.
